title: R--Professional Services for Construction Management Support
description: The DOI/BOR is preparing for a potential procurement for Professional Services for Construction Management Support.  A.	The Bureau of Reclamation requires construction management support services for infrastructure projects throughout the California Great Basin Region. This PWS covers the provision of two Materials Engineering Testing (MET) Level III, three Civil Construction Inspectors (CI) Level IV, and three Construction Management Services (CMS) Level IV personnel to support ongoing and future construction projects, including but not limited to: a.	 Arroyo Canal Fish Screen and Sack Dam Bypass Project, located near Dos Palos CA,  b.	B.F. Sisk Dam Safety of Dam and Reservoir Expansion Projects, Located near Santa Nella, CA c.	Trinity River Fish Hatchery Modernization Design Build Project, located near Lewiston CA.
